title: Speech Recorder prompt script
description: A list of prompts the Speech Recorder app reads aloud, one at a time, during a dictation. Further checks the app makes beyond this schema are listed in SPEC.md.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the file follows. The app refuses a higher number than it knows. Version 2 adds fields.

fields.description: Answers the script already knows, keyed by front matter field name (schemaVersion 2). A prompt whose key names one of these is not asked; the values are written to the manifest as promptRun.fields.

id.description: A stable name for the script: lower-case letters and digits in groups joined by single hyphens.

title.description: Shown in the app's list of scripts.

description.description: One or two lines about the script, kept with it for the people who write and read the file.

language.description: A BCP 47 language tag for the voice that reads the prompts. The phone's language when absent.

prompts.description: The prompts, in the order they are read.

id.description: A stable name, unique in the file. It does not change when the text is reworded, because recordings are matched to prompts by it.

key.description: The name of the front matter field the answer fills, for tools that read the recordings. Unique in the file.

hint.description: A note for the people who write and read the file. Never read aloud.
